moments.author: Brit Hume
moments.quote: “The WH has generally avoided defying court orders but appears to have done just that this morning.”
moments.why: Sharp callout of Trump WH ignoring a judge’s order restoring access to CNN, MS NOW, Politico—sparking widespread outrage.

moments.author: White House (official account)
moments.quote: ‘TRUMP THE TRANSPARENT’ — claims unprecedented press access far surpassing prior presidents.
moments.why: Administration’s self‑praise amid a press‑ban controversy is fueling mockery and debate about real transparency.

moments.author: Mike DeFabo
moments.quote: “Rico Dowdle (toe) is wearing a boot ... remains day‑to‑day.”
moments.why: Astute injury update on Steelers’ RB trending in fantasy circles and football discussions.

moments.author: Adam McCalvy
moments.quote: “Brandon Woodruff ... will have more imaging of his shoulder on Friday ... before deciding mound throwing.”
moments.why: Crucial postseason injury update on Brewers ace sparking chatter in baseball and fantasy circles.

moments.author: Jayden Reed
moments.quote: “Doing much better, appreciate all the prayers and support”
moments.why: Heartening recovery update after scary cart removal, resonating strongly with NFL fans.
